title: 第21章 新的师弟第22章 危机再临
slug: 苟在仙宗打铁悄悄修成道祖
lines: 杂役堂广场，场面一度悄悄的。
李牧火身边，杂役堂主管也都听傻了，看傻子一样看着李牧火。
你炼器坊什么风评，你自己不知道吗？要求这么多，还要会做饭，这是要把人往死里用是吧？
当然，嘴上那位杂役主管还是和气地建议道：“道友，你这条件未免太苛刻了些，要不降低点？”
李牧火压根没想招铁匠，就那点儿宗门任务，都不够他自己炼的，哪还想要招人？
当即，他便摇头：“没法降了，没经验的杂役弟子，培养难度太大，所以这次我们坊宁愿不招，也不乱招。”
李牧火纯粹只是来走个过场，证明自己来了，非是故意不招人，要不然钱朵朵和陈功那边都不好解释。
至于宗门会不会直派杂役弟子过去，那就无所谓了。钱朵朵他们便是最好的例子，这种被强制性派下来的杂役弟子，志不在炼器，他便也无所谓。
然而，正当李牧火觉得没人会来时，却见人群里一个普通少年走了出来。
之所以说普通，因为太没有记忆点了，属于放在人群里，眨眼就忘了的那类人。
王北川终究还是出列了，只见它抱拳行礼，掷地有声地说出了他临时瞎编的人设道：“弟子王北川，天资愚钝，幸而祖上留下炼器传承，荫蔽至今。弟子不怕苦，不怕累，只想一心钻研炼器之道，为宗门发光发热。”
“等等，这不是我的词么？”
李牧火深深地看了眼这个叫王北川的，此人的话和自己当初的那翻话，好像除了字不一样，意思竟分毫不差，连祖上的背景都是如出一辙。
该不会这家伙也能收集天地精粹吧？
这一刻，李牧火承认他慌了，抢活干的要来了。
只是，人家都说到这份上了，他若是不要，这就明显有问题了。
当即，李牧火热情走上前去，抓住王北川的手道：“师弟，你的决定是明智的。”
李牧火将大师兄的话套用过来，拉着王北川就要走。
然而，还没等走出两步，便又听一人道：“弟子白小山，略通烹饪之道，虽不会锻造，但愿意学，希望师兄成全。”
怎么又来一个，难不成炼器坊的风评变好了？
李牧火满心不解，自己那会儿可就只有自己这一个愿意当冤大头的。
待他看去，却是微微一愣，这少年，好像每一次有人挑人，他都会站出来，但每一次又都会被筛掉。
原因很简单，这少年太瘦弱了，长得还不好看。
旁边，杂役主管低声道：“道友，难得有人主动，机不可失啊！”
李牧火略一犹豫，便点了点头答应了。
他心想，收一个也是收，收两个也是收，自己还能多一份矿资。
相比于王北川，这个白小山对自己明显没什么威胁，倒是不用太放在心上。
片刻后。
李牧火带着两人走出了杂役堂。
路上，李牧火习惯性地发动了太乙炼瑕经，扫了眼两人。
结果这不看不知道，一看吓一跳。
白小山是没问题的，五行灵根与自己没多大差别，但这王北川，体内竟藏着一股精纯灵气，已经有液化的倾向，这分明是练气后期的标志。
“练气后期？”
李牧火心头一震，知道此人绝不简单，练气后期竟能瞒过他的探查，这人身上怕是修炼了某种不俗的隐匿功法。
content_en:
The scene in the Yitangtang Square was quiet for a while.
Next to Li Muhuo, the supervisor of the handyman hall was also dumbfounded and looked at Li Muhuo like a fool.
Don’t you know the reputation of your weapon refining workshop? Having so many demands and being able to cook is going to kill people, right?
Of course, the handyman supervisor still suggested kindly: "Fellow Taoist, your conditions are too harsh, why don't you lower them?"
Li Muhuo didn't want to recruit a blacksmith at all. The sect tasks were not enough for him to practice on his own, so why would he want to recruit someone?
Immediately, he shook his head: "There is no way to surrender. It is too difficult to train inexperienced handyman disciples, so this time our workshop would rather not recruit them than recruit them randomly."
Li Muhuo was just here to go through the motions and prove that he was here. Unless he deliberately refused to recruit people, it would be difficult for Qian Duoduo and Chen Gong to explain otherwise.
As for whether the sect will directly send handyman disciples there, that doesn't matter. Qian Duoduo and the others were the best example. It didn't matter to him that such handyman disciples who were forcibly sent down were not interested in refining weapons.
However, just when Li Muhuo thought no one would come, he saw an ordinary boy walking out of the crowd.
The reason why I say it is ordinary is because it has very little memory. It belongs to the type of people who are forgotten in the blink of an eye.
Wang Beichuan finally came out of the queue, and saw it clasping his fists in salute, and said loudly and loudly the persona he had made up on the spot: "Disciple Wang Beichuan, has a dull talent, but fortunately his ancestors left a legacy of weapon refining, which has protected him to this day. Disciple is not afraid of hardship or tiredness, he just wants to study the art of weapon refining and shine for the sect."
"Huh?"
"Wait, isn't that my word?"
Li Muhuo took a deep look at the man named Wang Beichuan. His words seemed to be the same as his original translation, except for the words, but the meaning was exactly the same. Even the background of his ancestors was exactly the same.
Could it be that this guy can also collect the essence of heaven and earth?
At this moment, Li Muhuo admitted that he was panicking and was about to grab a job.
However, everyone is talking about this, and if he doesn’t want it, there will obviously be a problem.
Immediately, Li Muhuo walked forward enthusiastically, grabbed Wang Beichuan's hand and said: "Junior brother, your decision is wise."
Li Muhuo applied his elder brother's words and pulled Wang Beichuan away.
However, before he could take two steps, he heard another person say: "Disciple Bai Xiaoshan, I have some knowledge of cooking. Although I don't know how to forge, I am willing to learn. I hope that my senior brother will succeed."
Why is there another one? Could it be that the reputation of the weapon refining workshop has improved?
Li Muhuo was puzzled. At that time, he was the only one willing to be taken advantage of.
When he looked at it, he was slightly stunned. This young man seemed to stand up every time someone picked someone, but he would be screened out every time.
The reason is simple. This young man is too thin and not good-looking.
Next to him, the handyman supervisor whispered: "Fellow Taoist, it's rare for someone to take the initiative. This opportunity cannot be missed!"
Li Muhuo hesitated for a moment, then nodded and agreed.
He thought to himself that if he collected one, he would still receive it, if he collected two, he would still receive it, and he would still have an extra share of mineral resources.
Compared to Wang Beichuan, this Bai Xiaoshan obviously poses no threat to him, so he doesn't need to take it too seriously.
After a while.
Li Muhuo led the two of them out of the handyman hall.
On the way, Li Muhuo habitually activated the Taiyi Refining Imperfections Sutra and glanced at the two of them.
As a result, I didn’t know what to look at, and I was shocked when I saw it.
There was no problem with Bai Xiaoshan. The Five Elements spiritual roots were not much different from his own, but Wang Beichuan actually had a pure spiritual energy hidden in his body, which was already tending to liquefy. This was clearly a sign of the late stage of Qi training.
"Later stage of Qi training?"
Li Muhuo was shocked. He knew that this person was not simple. He was able to hide from his detection in the late stage of Qi training. This person was probably practicing some kind of good concealment technique.
